notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. A macOS connectivity diagnostic workflow that isolates the fault domain (local-link/LAN, DNS, upstream-path, remote-service/application, inconclusive) using built-in tools and an evidence-labelled result format.

It has the agent run bounded, read-only probes: `ping -c 5`, `scutil --dns`, `dig +time=2 +tries=1`, `traceroute -n -q 1 -m 20`, `nettop -n -L 3`, `networkQuality`, and a GET-only `curl -w` timing request with timeouts to the user's affected URL (SKILL.md:52-108). Acceptable as low: the skill explicitly forbids changing interfaces, DNS, firewall/VPN settings, flushing caches, installing packages, or sending state-changing requests (SKILL.md:20, 157-166; details.md:38, 181, 195, 207, 213), and tells the agent to quote the URL as one argument to avoid shell injection.

The Related Skills list (SKILL.md:174-178) names sibling skills `incident-runbook-templates`, `on-call-handoff-patterns`, `postmortem-writing` by name only; they are optional and not needed for this workflow. Probes do send traffic to the user's target hosts.
